title: clauder-workbench fan-out contract
description: Contract consumed by clauder-workbench fanout-plan / fanout-run / merge-gate. One worker per child R process; each emits a state/manifest/validation triple under artifacts.output_root.

task_key.description: Stable task identity used for inflight registration and evidence linkage.

max_parallel.description: Default concurrency level if not overridden on the CLI.

requires_native_smoke.description: When true, fanout-plan/run/poll/merge-gate require fresh parent evidence from clauder-workbench native-smoke complete before proceeding.

max_age_min.description: Maximum age, in minutes, of accepted native-smoke parent evidence.

output_root.description: Base dir for worker outputs. Relative worker paths resolve against this (relative output_root resolves against the contract file's directory). Use forward slashes.

max_age_h.description: merge-gate rejects worker outputs older than this many hours (freshness guard).

memory_threshold.description: Memory percent ceiling for the advise/enforce concurrency decision.

require_soak_monitor.description: Require fresh matching soak_monitor PASS evidence during strict completion-check.

soak_monitor_max_age_min.description: Maximum age of accepted soak_monitor parent evidence.

monitor.description: Long-soak resource, heartbeat, recovery, and safety policy.

code_file.description: Path to the R worker file. Either code_file or code is required.

code.description: Inline R code. Either code_file or code is required.

session.description: Optional RStudio session name to bind the worker to.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the worker. NEVER place credentials here; use the environment at run time.

expected_state.description: state_<id>.json path (relative to output_root). status=='complete' is the done signal.
